# Location of the MACA Toolkit
MACA_PATH ?= /opt/maca

# Compiler
MXCC           = $(MACA_PATH)/mxgpu_llvm/bin/mxcc
# Internel flags
MXCCFLAGS     := -x maca
ARCHFLAGS     := -offload-arch native
################################################################################
# Target rules
all: profilerScope

profilerScope: profilerScope.cpp
	$(MXCC) $(MXCCFLAGS) $(ARCHFLAGS) $< -o $@ --maca-path=$(MACA_PATH)

run: profilerScope
	./profilerScope --profile-from-start

clean:
	rm -rf profilerScope profilerScope.o tdump.mem tdump.txt
